units.source_text: 此种琐屑之事，源氏公子本人曾努力隐讳，用心良苦，故作者本拟省略不谈。

en.t: Matters as trifling as these, Prince Genji himself had taken great pains to conceal, and so the author had originally intended to pass over them in silence.

units.source_text: 但恐读者以为“此乃帝王之子，故目击其事之作者，亦一味隐恶扬善”，

en.t: But fearing that readers might think, "Because he is the son of an emperor, the author who witnessed these events also merely hides his faults and praises his virtues,"

units.source_text: 便将此物语视为虚构，因此作者不得不如实记载。

en.t: and might therefore regard this tale as fiction, the author has no choice but to record the facts truthfully.
The charge of being unkind, then, can hardly be avoided.
